record.question: Fa Hien was
options: the first Buddhist pilgrim of China to visit India during the reign of Chandragupta Vikramaditya
the discoverer of Puerto Rico and Jamaica
the first Buddhist pilgrim of India to visit China
record.explanation: Answer A: the first Buddhist pilgrim of China to visit India during the reign of Chandragupta Vikramaditya. Faxian (Fa Hien) was a Chinese Buddhist monk who travelled to India in the early fifth century, during the Gupta period associated with Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya).
